name: rosetta-longest-common-substring
code:
use default

substrings(text: string) -> Pipe[string] is
    for start in 0..text.length do
        for finish in (start + 1)::text.length do
            yield text[start..finish]
        od
    od
si

longest_common(left: string, right: string) -> string =>
    substrings(left)
        |> filter(candidate => right.index_of(candidate) >= 0)
        |> reduce("", (best, candidate) =>
            if candidate.length > best.length then
                candidate
            else
                best
            fi)

write_line(longest_common("thisisatest", "testing123testing"))
